title: Automated Quality Gate for Fintech Microservices
business: A high-velocity fintech engineering team managing dozens of microservices that must adhere to strict internal compliance standards.
problem: The team faces significant bottlenecks during peer reviews, where senior engineers spend excessive time manually verifying CLAUDE.md compliance and basic bug patterns, leading to delayed releases and inconsistent feedback loops.
solution: The Code Review plugin deploys specialized parallel agents to handle repetitive verification tasks. By utilizing confidence-based filtering, the system ensures that only high-probability issues—such as non-compliance with architectural guidelines or identified bug patterns—are surfaced to human reviewers, effectively filtering out noise.
steps: Configure the repository with a CLAUDE.md file defining the specific architectural and compliance standards for the microservice.
Trigger the /code-review command on a new pull request to initiate the parallel agent analysis.
Set the confidence threshold to 85 to ensure that only highly relevant, actionable feedback is posted to the GitHub PR.
Review the generated comments, which include direct SHA-linked references to specific code lines for rapid remediation.
outcome: Engineers experience a reduction in manual review overhead, allowing them to focus on complex architectural logic rather than routine compliance checks, resulting in a more predictable and streamlined development lifecycle.
limitation: The system relies heavily on the quality of the provided CLAUDE.md file; if the documentation is ambiguous, the agents may produce inconsistent findings. This can be verified by auditing the confidence scores of findings related to documentation-specific rules versus generic bug detection.
